kjv: no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only
mine: not even the angels of heaven, nor the Son, but the Father only
note: Sinaiticus, Vaticanus (original hand), Bezae and others include "oude ho huios" ("nor the Son"); TR omits it, likely an early omission because the admission of the Son's ignorance was doctrinally awkward (it stands undisputed at Mark 13:32).

kjv: and of the end of the world
mine: and of the end of the age
note: synteleia tou aionos is the consummation of the present age (as at 13:39); "world" shifts the question to the end of the physical cosmos.
TR adds "kai loimoi" ("and pestilences", a wordplay with limoi) from Luke 21:11; absent from Sinaiticus and Vaticanus.

kjv: there will the eagles be gathered together
note: aetoi gathering at a carcass are vultures (the Greek word covers both); eagles do not flock to corpses.
